headline: Committee discusses DHHL well agreement, defers road herbicide waiver

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.summary: Under the draft agreement, DHHL would receive all of the wells' estimated 1.728 million gallons per day, and an amendment passed seven to zero. Public Works' waiver request was deferred; a member wants specific areas and a shorter time period when it returns.
meeting.recap: Under the draft agreement, DHHL would receive all of the wells' estimated 1.728 million gallons of water per day.[[0:11:37]] A council member asked why the county would not keep some of the water, as in other DHHL projects.[[0:28:04]] The amendment passed with seven ayes and zero noes.[[0:58:05]] Public Works asked for a temporary waiver to use weed killer (herbicide) in safety areas along county roads.[[1:00:30]] One council member asked for specific areas and a shorter time period when the request comes back.[[2:09:37]] The chair said the herbicide waiver will be deferred.[[2:12:06]]
meeting.next: DHHL said it would provide a breakdown of its wait list at a later date. When the herbicide waiver returns, a council member wants specific areas and a shorter time period.

moments.q: "My family are all beneficiaries on the list, still waiting."
On steam weed equipment: "It's junk right now."
"It's kind of like painting a battleship."

issues.oneLine: DHHL says the new wells would support over a thousand homestead lots for Native Hawaiian families.
issues.why: DHHL said many people on its wait list are passing away before receiving a home.
issues.next: DHHL said it would provide a breakdown of its wait list at a later date.
issues.brief: The water deputy director said the deal helps DHHL get its beneficiaries housing quicker.[[#1]] DHHL said its residential wait list is almost 4,000 people.[[#2]] DHHL said advance water credits would cover 39.5% of its development needs right away.[[#3]] DHHL said the finished system could serve an estimated 2,880 homes for its beneficiaries.[[#4]]
